Shop By Fit:
Straight
A classic. The same width at the knee and at the leg opening.
Loose & Baggy
Easy, oversized fits with maximum space.
Relaxed
A straight fit with breathing room from hip to ankle.
Slim & Skinny
A sleek fit that’s narrow through the thigh and hugs the leg to the ankle.
Tapered
Roomy in the thigh and narrow at the ankle.
Bootcut
Narrower at the knee and wider at the ankle, to fit over your boots.
